specs.title: should be able to create a new person using the quick action section
should be able to assign faces to people
faces are automatically matched to people based on similarity
keyboard shortcuts enable quick face assignment
locations_map_displays_photo_markers - Map renders with markers for photos that have coordinates
locations_popup_shows_photo_details - Clicking a marker opens a popup with the photo, closing hides it
locations_filter_unnamed_photos - The unnamed-only filter narrows the map and unchecking restores it
locations_reverse_geocode_suggests_name - Selecting a cluster surfaces a reverse-geocoded name suggestion
locations_select_clusters_and_assign_name - Shift-drag selection assigns a location name to the photos
locations_clear_location_names - Clearing removes the names from the selected photos
gallery_loads_with_valid_images - Gallery displays photos and all image sources are valid (no broken links)
gallery_loads_with_valid_videos - Gallery displays videos with valid posters and inline playback works
gallery_filter_year_works - Should be able to find photos by filtering for year on the gallery page
gallery_page_navigation_works - Verify that the page navigation works
